# Lonely Planet

> > The world's leading travel guide publisher, offering comprehensive guidebooks, destination inspiration, and personalized travel planning services for every corner of the globe.

Lonely Planet provides expert travel content through guidebooks, ebooks, and digital resources covering destinations worldwide. The site features regional guides for Europe, Asia, Australia, and the Americas, alongside specialized collections like Best in Travel annual editions and curated weekend itineraries.

## Key Topics

- travel guidebooks
- destination guides

## Getting Started

- [Travel Guides & Travel Inspiration - Lonely Planet](https://auth.lonelyplanet.com/): Lonely Planet homepage with travel guides and destination inspiration
- [Lonely Planet Travel Guidebooks: Free Shipping & Immediate Delivery](https://shop.lonelyplanet.com/): Lonely Planet shop homepage with guidebooks, maps, and travel books
- [Lonely Planet Journeys - Lonely Planet](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/journeys): Custom travel planning service with personalized itineraries by experts

## Featured Collections

- [Lonely Planet's Best in Travel 2026 - Book](https://shop.lonelyplanet.com/products/lonely-planets-best-in-travel-2026): Annual Best in Travel 2026 with top 25 destinations and experiences
- [The World - Book](https://shop.lonelyplanet.com/products/the-world): Comprehensive global guidebook covering every country worldwide
- [100 Weekends in Europe](https://shop.lonelyplanet.com/products/100-weekends-in-europe): European weekend trip guide with 100 curated short-stay itineraries

## Europe Travel Guides

- [Eastern Europe Travel Book and Ebook](https://shop.lonelyplanet.com/products/eastern-europe?variant=44334068105467): Eastern Europe guidebook covering Dubrovnik, Krakow, and Moscow
- [Greece Travel Book and Ebook](https://shop.lonelyplanet.com/products/greece): Greece guidebook covering Greek Islands, Athens, and Crete

## Asia Travel Guides

- [Asia](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/destinations/asia): Asia destination hub covering Japan, China, Kazakhstan, and Vietnam
- [India Travel Guide](https://shop.lonelyplanet.com/products/india): India guidebook featuring Kerala, Rajasthan, and South India regions
- [Korea Travel Guide](https://shop.lonelyplanet.com/products/korea): Korea guidebook with Jeju-do, Changdeokgung, and Boryeong Mud Festival

## Regional Travel Guides

- [USA Travel Book and Ebook](https://shop.lonelyplanet.com/products/usa?variant=44323489710331): USA guidebook with national parks, cities, and highway routes
- [Australia Travel Guides | Lonely Planet](https://shop.lonelyplanet.com/collections/australia): Australia guidebook collection with Sydney, Brisbane, and Great Barrier Reef
